# Patina UI

> Let your users customize your app's views in plain language. The model returns validated, declarative patches against a schema you declare, never code. TypeScript packages: @patina-ui/core (manifest, patch engine), @patina-ui/server (handler, Anthropic adapter, storage), @patina-ui/react (renderer, headless UI), @patina-ui/cli (patina scan/check/insights/init-action/init-agent), plus a GitHub Action.

Coding agents integrating Patina UI into an app should follow the skill first: it has the rules, the step-by-step integration and the verification checklist.

## For coding agents

- [Agent skill: integrating Patina UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/paulocerez/patina/main/skills/patina-ui/SKILL.md): rules, steps, code, verification, common mistakes
